metadata.Name: CRAFT
metadata.Description: CRAFT is a dataset for cultural Russian-oriented dataset adaptation for focused text-to-image generation.
metadata.Paper Title: CRAFT: CULTURAL RUSSIAN-ORIENTED DATASET ADAPTATION FOR FOCUSED TEXT-TO-IMAGE GENERATION
metadata.Venue Name: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology (MIPT), Moscow, Russia
Information Technologies, Mechanics and Optics University (ITMO University), Saint-Petersburg, Russia
Artificial Intelligence Research Institute (AIRI), Moscow, Russia
metadata.Abstract: The abstract of the paper discusses the lack of cultural awareness in text-to-image generation models and proposes a methodology for collecting and processing data to form a dataset based on cultural code, specifically Russian culture. The authors analyze the effectiveness of their approach using the Kandinsky 3.1 text-to-image model and report human evaluation results demonstrating an increase in the level of awareness of Russian culture in the model.
